column3: With respect to the Tesla GR Mortgage Loan (1.5%), The Welk Group, Inc., the sole shareholder of one of the non-recourse carveout guarantors, Welk Real Estate, Inc., is the defendant in a lawsuit filed by the defendant’s former CEO in February 2024 and amended in May 2025 alleging age discrimination, wrongful termination, failure to prevent discrimination, and financial elder abuse, specifically seeking restitution of the benefits of his previous position with the financial and property holdings the plaintiff held at the time of his termination.
